name: lozenge
title: Lozenge
description: A short status word in a colored pill, one meaning per tone.

when: Showing the state of an item: draft, paid, overdue.

guidance.rule: The word carries the meaning, never the color alone; use sentence case.
Use the bold appearance sparingly, for the one status that matters most.

builtIn: Text meets WCAG AA in both appearances.
youProvide: A status word that makes sense without color.

genui.description: A status word ("Paid", "Overdue"). Pick the tone by meaning: success, warning, danger, information, brand or neutral.
